items.name: Iliza Shlesinger: Free Nights & Weekends
items.caption:
Six Netflix specials later, Iliza Shlesinger is touring Free Nights & Weekends.
Iliza Shlesinger performs at Bayou Music Center on February 13, 2027. Her Netflix special Hot Forever premiered in 2022. Tickets on sale now. Link in bio.
